purpose: Ba phiên bản tham khảo bổ sung, cùng bối cảnh và khác đồ họa; không loại hoặc thay thế bản cũ

prompts.A: Use case: stylized-concept. VISUAL MEDIUM A: bold hand-drawn 2D animation / CEL-SHADED game art. Confident variable-width dark contour lines, expressive angular but dignified adult character designs, clear shape rhythm, TWO OR THREE decisively separated shadow values per material, solid local color, crisp hard shadow shapes with very limited softening, reduced detail in backgrounds. Actual carefully drawn contours, not brushy realist surfaces. Deliberate mature stylization, not cute chibi or glossy anime merchandise. Bamboo poles and tree trunks simplified into expressive curves and wedges; foreground leaf masses are elegant simple graphic shapes. Palette uses moss and jade greens, rusty clay earth, faded indigo cloth and bone ivory; small brick-red sash on arriving character. Neutral soft sky light, restrained highlights. Aim for a distinctive playable hand-animated world with character presence. No painterly noise, no photographic texture, no all-over beige wash, no 3D plastic rendering. Wide 16:9 image-only concept of an imagined living-world narrative RPG inspired by a fictional ancient Vietnamese village. This is a game SCREEN view, not a poster. Shared scene and composition: an elevated three-quarter view of a modest bamboo-and-thatch healer's stilt house on a gently terraced green hillside. A broad earth path curves from lower left toward the porch at upper center. A clear shallow stream passes on the right under one simple bamboo footbridge; an asymmetrical broad-leaved tree frames the left edge. An adult arriving with a basket of herbs on their back is on the path, a practitioner kneels on the porch arranging a plain woven cloth and clay bowls, and an elder with a family member waits seated on the porch edge. Four readable adult figures, ordinary work and relationships; no weapons, no healing magic, no clinical medical instructions or identifiable cure. A few baskets and herbs, not a crowded fantasy alchemy laboratory. Morning after rain, visible open movement space, quiet natural landscape and strong focus on people near the porch. Vietnamese vernacular bamboo/stilt architecture and plain woven garments as creative fiction, not historical reconstruction; no tiled pagodas, torii, lantern strings or European medieval inn. No words, letters, UI, title, frame or logo. Keep the specific visual medium below unmistakable, not photographic realism.
prompts.B: Use case: stylized-concept. VISUAL MEDIUM B: an extraordinary WORLD WOVEN ENTIRELY FROM DYED THREAD, like a sophisticated contemporary interactive tapestry. It must NOT be a conventional painting printed onto fabric. Every character silhouette, hillside, roof, tree, water ripple and shadow is visibly assembled from warp and weft, satin stitches, knotted tufts and parallel woven bands; small open gaps reveal the underlying ivory weave. Flat graphic woven motifs turn into an explorable coherent place. Baskets are loops of tan thread, leaves are dense green thread clusters, the stream is flowing silver-blue parallel yarn, thatch is straw-colored diagonal stitched bands. Human figures have simple dignified proportions and individual poses, faces indicated economically with a few dark stitches, no stuffed toy bodies, no plush dolls. Layered textile thickness casts only delicate local contact shadows, no realistic lighting or fake blur. Large calm unembroidered ground regions make walkable paths readable. Deep indigo, subdued leaf green, warm ivory, rusty ochre and one small cinnabar accent. View should look like a playable living tapestry created from actual fiber structures, not a decorative carpet hanging in a room, not an image inside a frame. This is an original graphic experiment, NOT a claim about actual ancient Vietnamese textile art. prompts.C: Use case: stylized-concept. VISUAL MEDIUM C: a refined STYLIZED 3D GAME APPEARANCE with strongly designed FACETED solid forms, as a concept illustration only. Chunky clean geometry, confident planar surfaces, angular rocks and terrain terraces, carefully grouped low-poly foliage, simplified bamboo joints, clear human poses and human adult proportions. Geometry feels intentionally authored and materially legible, not random triangulated noise, not toy diorama, not clay/plastic, not photorealism. No black drawn outlines; plane changes and shadows describe forms. Matte silver-grey aged timber, fresh muted green foliage, pale brown moist earth, indigo woven cloth; pale blue stream stones are visible through shallow water. Neutral late-morning diffuse light with soft short cast shadows and clear light/dark grouping; NO golden-hour cinematic grade, no teal-orange LUT, no bloom, no lens effects, no depth of field. Compact playable environmental composition at ordinary human scale, not an island displayed on a plinth. A vivid, calm, genuinely shaped world where professions and social life matter. This should only IMAGINE what a stylized 3D game might look like: do not imply a real model, engine or runtime output.
